description: El mejor simulador de misión jamás creado!!!
summary: Junior Mission is a retro 8-bit strategy game that turns children aged 7 to 12 into the commander of a research base on Mars. Over 10 sols (Martian days), players must collect 15 science points while keeping their crew alive and safe from radiation. It is a mission simulator for junior astronauts: instead of memorising facts, kids experience the real trade-offs of living on another planet, where every decision helps one thing and costs another.
details:
How does it work?

Each turn is one sol. The player reads the state of the base and the messages from Mission Control, chooses up to two missions, and then sees exactly what changed and why. There are three resources to protect (energy, life support and shield) plus a radiation dose that must stay below 10. Before starting, the player picks a commander class (engineer, doctor or physicist), two real astronauts with their own strengths, weaknesses and special skills, and one living experiment (lettuce, tardigrades or mice). A shuffled deck of events brings solar storms based on real NASA records, dust storms and equipment failures. Mission Control’s warnings arrive one sol late, so the commander often has to decide alone, just like a real crew on Mars. After each storm the game shows the maths (strength − shield = dose), and when a mission fails it explains the cause so the player can learn and try again
dataRefs: NASA astronaut biographies: Franklin Chang-Díaz, Chiaki Mukai and Sally Ride
